why: v53-v57: varying all MR orbitals together leaves rotations within {1s,2s} and each complete Rydberg manifold free; the strict criterion never converges and leading labels permute (v57 even_A). Standard practice removes the freedom: optimise spectroscopic orbitals one at a time on their own series with earlier orbitals frozen.
scope: Per parity, steps (even: core 2p4 vary 1s,2s,2p; then 3p,4p,5p,6p,4f,5f; odd: core 2p3 3s vary 1s,2s,2p,3s; then 4s,5s,6s,3d,4d,5d). Each step: Li MCDHF MR configurations of the families included so far (all parents, 0 excitations), 2J over the targeted J, EOL on the lowest K targeted states per J (Li families), standard weights, strict rmcdhf with method 3 for the varied orbital(s) via the v56 non-default path, 500 cycles, previous orbitals frozen (rwfnestimate previous, then TF, then screened hydrogenic). Final step per parity = the full s0 list (must equal v56 blocks). Then rbiotransform + rtransition E1 between final even and odd.
guards: Fresh directory; prlimit --as=12 GiB; budgets as v53; disk guard 40 GiB. Stop and FAILED_RETAINED on any refusal, native stop, iteration limit, strict criterion unmet for the varied orbitals, prompt mismatch, identity (leading families per J of the included targets) differing, final list differing from v56, or missing table.
evidence: Receipt and every native file archived.
outcome: FAILED_RETAINED at even_5_4f (native IN stop: 4f j=7/2 continuum-like). Even core 5.4e-8 and 3p/4p/5p/6p (3.5e-8/5.2e-8/8.1e-9/5.9e-8) converged strictly with correct Li families (reproducing v59 on per-series lists). In the 4f-only step the targeted states carry 4f j=7/2 occupation 4.2e-8 (J=5 target is a single CSF without f7/2), so f7/2 is unweighted and wanders. nf target selection is an open method choice. Archive data/audit/rya1354/mcdhf_s0_sequential_failed_v60.
change_from_v58: The lifetime ladder half grid (RNT=exp(-65/16)/8 unchanged, H=0.03125, N=439, HP=0, explicit original ACCY 5.9604644775390625e-8) in both rwfnestimate and rmcdhf, as documented successful in docs/audit/rya1354/lifetime_continuation_v4.md; prompt strings pinned to rya1354_radial_controls.initialization_input and the ladder grid answers. Everything else identical to v58.
change_from_v59: Each Rydberg orbital is optimised on its own l-series only: list = 2p3 n'l for n' up to the current n (all parents, so lower orbitals of that l stay and orthogonality holds), EOL on the 4S-parent targets of that series (odd s-series also keeps the 2p3(2D)3s targets of the 3s configuration), core (1s,2s,2p and odd 3s from the core step) fixed; ground states are no longer in Rydberg EOLs. rwfnestimate reads every earlier step of the parity (newest first; frozen orbitals are carried unchanged), then TF, then screened hydrogenic. A final fixed-orbital CI step (pinned standard rmcdhf, nothing varied; native SCF exits at cycle 1 when no orbital is varied) over the full s0 list (must equal v56) gives the 45 even / 36 odd states, identity-checked; E1 from those. Half grid, method 3, strict criterion for every varied orbital and all guards unchanged.
